title: Restore Main Display clock dominance and circular preset controls
verify: Before any production write, obtain fresh task-scoped RED from the current Main Display source and deterministic host geometry/contact-sheet probe at the existing 1280x720 model. Record actual HH:mm view/glyph bounds as left/top/right/bottom/width/height and each existing right-side preset bound plus effective radius. Current source-derived baseline is clock region [271,24,1028,252] (757x228); preset model bounds [(1028,24,1248,248),(1028,248,1248,472),(1028,472,1248,696)] (220x224 each) with cornerRadius 18f. These are baseline observations, not product targets. Do not reuse W21, W22 or W23 evidence as RED.

Implement only the Main Display visual correction in DisplayCapability.kt and focused DisplayProjectionTest.kt support: make idle HH:mm visually dominant in the central/upper region and make the three existing right-side preset controls true circles. Preserve TimerPresetSlot order, labels, colors, selected/active styling, click listeners and the existing Main Display-to-Timer & Alert path; do not change TimerCapability, audio, W23 behavior or timer lifecycle semantics.

Obtain claim-equivalent GREEN with the same host measurement and rendered contact-sheet route. Measured clock bounds must show a clear dominant focal hierarchy against city/date and transient text, remain central/upper above Today/Tomorrow/Day-after, and avoid clipping or overlap. All three existing preset controls must remain right-side and have equal width, equal height, width equal to height, one common effective radius, and radius at least half the common measured side within integer rounding. Preserve the four ordered weather slots, Today-versus-three-equal-smaller relation, card projection ownership and existing gaps.

Apply the reference visual rubric to the same-size RED/GREEN contact sheet with a named Reviewer/visual-QA role: clock is the first focal point; left city/date, central clock, lower four-card shell and right controls retain the reference anchors; circular controls have balanced whitespace and no clipping; the result stays lightweight/static and adds no labels, effects, controls or new visual system. Record each rubric row PASS/FAIL with decisive bounds or observation; no absolute product dp or ratio is introduced.

Run the clean build, complete host unit suite and static diff gate. Retain focused regressions for device-time clock/date, colon states, city/settings routing, card order/projection semantics and timer preset/countdown/overdue/audio behavior. The regression proof must show TimerCapability, PlatformRuntimeAdapter and W23 audio paths were not changed or re-owned.

Record Samsung GT-I9300I Android 11 custom-ROM 1280x720 readability/fullscreen/keep-screen-on and actual runtime circular rendering as DEFERRED with residual risk when no authorized target observation exists. Host geometry/contact-sheet evidence must never be promoted to target-device runtime PASS. This planning run does not launch an emulator/device, use adb, network or credentials.

Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-001 if qualitative reference matching cannot be satisfied without a new absolute clock size, dp or ratio. Stop and route to /spec-design if execution needs a new module, owner, graph edge, public contract, dependency, event path, resource pipeline or composition-root business logic. Stop before any write outside the two-file boundary or any lifecycle, scheduler, checkpoint, terminal-state or prior-task change.
